content: Jesus Ye Hafdalerloh Mokwe Redabeyal We Seg Mo Rumal
Jesus ye ffesang fengalir chowe seg mo rumal. Yesa fang kkameler mo kkeler bo be yoh le rebe hachuchu moniyan mo metmetal tomay mo uwol yarmat.
Yesa hagloyur bo re bela foloyu ngal yarmat kofal mala Lamliyel Deus ngo re hachuya yar yarmat tomay.

Imol molwe Jesus yebe hagloyurloh ngo yesa kangalur bo, “Ha bele loh irel malekah le tor mele habe hasi. Ha towe kak sohmi mo yami botow mo yami paey mo lomi salpiy. Liwilil mwo mekla mengagmi ngo ha towe kak.
Te tugul sew imw solboy le rebe hammalgumi mo iyang ngo hasa mel chol irel imw yee la hola yodla habe chuytang haplom la iyang.
Sew haplom le yarmat rebe te hammalgumi mo iyang ngo hasa yuchgaloh bol haplom la mo irel pechemi bo habe hagulal ngalir bo tayikof molwe resa foru.”
Iwe resa loh chowe seg mo rumal wol sew mo sew haplom bo re bela foloyu kofal Hapatpat Momay we ngo re hachuya yar yarmat tomay.
Yael Yerodes Somawel Fedal
Yodwe Yerodes we tamol wol Galilee yela rongrong kofal pangal mokwe yesa weldoh ngo sa kkel yal somawel fedal bo tot yarmat re sor bo Johannes Baptista yesa molow tefael mo irel maes.
Iwe ngo sibis re sor bo yesa llahdoh Elijah ngo tot re sor le semal profeta kowe muswe mele yesa molow tefael.
Yerodes sa sor bo, “Ngang molwe isor bo rebe supiloh molwe chemel Johannes. Ila ngo itey mal le isa rongrong kaptal?” Iwe ye sala ye yedamgel fedal mele be yoh le be wiri Jesus iyang.
Jesus Ye Hamngoyur Limngeras Mal
Rela tefael chowe seg mo rumal resa budoh kangal Jesus pangal mokwe resa foru. Iwe Jesus yesa palir resa loh wol sew haplom le Bethsaida idal le rol ir chog.
Yodwe yarmat cholop rela rongrong kofal yal loh ngo resa meriloh. Jesus yesa ffesangur sa kangalur kofal molwe Lamliyel Deus ngo ye hachuya yar tomay rechokla re tomay.

Yela harep dolol yaal ngo chowe seg mo rumal resa budoh irel Jesus resa kangalu bo, “Hole halahor yarmat bo rebe loh woal milay kala ye repdoh mo hasohsoh bo re bela ffaeg fedal haler mo lobos le rebe mel iyang. Lobos le ila ye halugloh ngo tor loh formel iyang.”
Iwe ngo Jesus yesa kangalur bo, “Ha fang haler hami.” Iwe ngo resa sor bo, “Hal limay flowa mo rumal yig mele ye mel iremem. Hare ho luluwaley bo habe loh ha bela chuwaydoh haler buwa le iye leper?”
(Malbo be limngeras mal lobowe.) Jesus yesa kangalur mokwe redabeyal bo, “Ha kangalur yarmat bo rebe marodiy le rebe sew mo sew buwa le be kalemeg iyang.”
Yela mol yar mokwe redabeyal foru mokwe ye sor,
ngo Jesus yesa hasi flowa we limay mo yig we rumal sa kaledah wol laeng, sa kangalu Deus yal hachigchig sa depiy flowa kowe mo yig kowe sa ngaler mokwe redabeyal bo re be yildi uwor yarmat.
Panger yarmat ngo re mongoy ngo ye laploh haler iyang. Mokwe redabeyal resa hateyili fengali lutgul mongoy kowe ngo ye ssog seg mo ruwow bachebach iyang.
Pedrus Ye Sor Mala Halongol Kofal Jesus
Seral le Jesus loh chog yal memapel ngo mokwe redabeyal resa budoh irel. Iwe ngo Jesus yesa kasiyar bo, “Yarmat dolap re sor bo Ngang itey?”
Iwe ngo ir resa sor bo, “Sibis re sor bo gel Johannes Baptista ngo sibis re sor bo gel Elijah ngo wol tot re sor bo gel semal profeta kowe muswe le yesa molow tefael.”
“Iwe ngo Jesus yesa kasiyar, “Iwe ngo hami ha sor bo Ngang itey?” Pedrus yesa sor bo, “Gel Kristus we ye budoh mo irel Deus.”
Jesus Ye Kapta Kofal Yal Be Hafohoy Mo Yal Be Mes
Iwe ngo Jesus yesa kangalur ngalir bo, “Ha hafali chog bo tor semal le habe kangalu le ngang Kristus.

Jesus ye wol kangalur bo, “Mala Layur Retalop ila yebe kkel yal hafohoy. Mal kowe yar mo tamol temarong kowe mo mokwe sensel Hatobtob we re bele fangloh iy. Rebe limeseloh ngo bela solral mo wol miril ngo yebe molow tefael mo irel maes.”
Jesus yesa kangalur pangarloh, “Hare semal ye dipli bo be dabeyey ngo be maliglaloh kofal lufulyal ngo pangal ral ngo be hasi yal krud yesa dabeyey.
Semal le yebe hachangi yal nngas ngo yebe pung tangi, ngo te tugul semal le yebe mes le fal ngang ngo yebe molow.
Meda mmalel semal le ye bela lamliloh faileng le ngo ye teyoh ngali molow la tor siyal.
Hare semal le be maa irey mo foloy ka yai ila ngo mala Layur Retalop be wol maa irel. Irel yodla yebe budoh luwul falmay la yal mo mala Temal mo angelus kala re santus.
Ibe hatugulu ngalugmi le yor tot yarmat le re mel iga le re towe pagel mes ngo resa wiri mala Lamliyel Deus.”
Jesus We Ye Yusuwweloh Molwe Woel
Bele sew week mo wol miril yal sor meka ngo Jesus yesa pali Pedrus mo John mo James resa bidah wol sew tayit bo re bela mapel.
Yodwe Jesus ye memapel ngo sa wel loh woal molwe metal. Iwe ngo mokwe mengagul ila sa bbechragloh le ye mmaluplup.
Re tedaploh ngo sa mel rumal mal irel Jesus le resa kapatpat ngali. Mal kowe ila Moses mo Elijah.
Re lahdoh luwul mala falmayel laeng le re kakapta kofal yal bela foru mala depel Deus le iy Jesus bele la mes wol Jerusalem.
Pedrus mo mokwe choluwal resa rol kkul masorloh. Rela mmatloh re sala wiri falmay we yael Jesus mo mal we rumal we re su lengchel.

Yodwe re loh chowe rumal ngo Pedrus yesa kangalu Jesus bo, “Masta, ifa lepal momayel mele hamem hala mel iga! Ha bele hasu suluw imw bo sew imwom, ngo sew imwel Moses ngo sew imwel Elijah.” (Pedrus ye sosor mokwe le ye togla fal.)
Yodwe ye chil kapatpat ngo sedep darmi sa llurdoh uwor ngo yesa kkel loh yar motog mokwe re dabeyel Jesus irel darmi we yesa halururloh.
Iwe ngo yesa mmalilidiy Deus mo luwul darmi we le ye sor bo, “Iye mele layi le iy hartal hachangi, ha talenga yalol!”
Yodwe la ppoloh yalol yarmat we ngo sa Jesus loh chog mele ye mel loboswe. Ngo mokwe redabeyel Jesus rete kapta kofal mele. Tor semal le re kangalu fael yodla mokwe re wiri.
Jesus Ye Hachuya Moniyan Mo Uwol Semal Yalwich Tarmal
Ralawe seral ngo Jesus mo mokwe redabeyal we solmol re sala bidiy mo wol tayit we ngo sew buwal yarmat resa budoh irel Jesus.
Semal mal yesa tawul mo luwul buwa we le ye sor bo, “Sensey, fael pechem ngo hobe kemahoy tarmal le layi bo iye chog layi iye.
Yebe ddidoh moniyan la uwol ngo yema tawul ngo ye piyom ngo ye buyoy burbur mo lal yewal. Iwe ngo moniyan le yema hawsu fedaley ngo ye weres le yebe chuy mo uwol.
Iy sa hafael pecher meka redabeyem bo rebe hachuya moniyan le mo uwol ngo ye temmal ngalir.”

Jesus yesa sor bo, “Ila lepal yami te luglug mo machey! Be ifa lepal sulayel yai mel ngalugmi ngo hasa moch medaf? Be ifa lepal yai halelayiloh chog repiyey iremi?” Iwe ngo yesa kangalu mal we bo, “Hasidoh tarmal la lom iga.”

Yodwe yesa bubudoh tarmal we ngo moniyan we uwol yesa pedadiy wototol le yesa piyom. Jesus yesa kkasigsig ngal moniyan we bo be chuy mo uwol tarmal we. Iwe ngo yesa chuy moniyan we mo uwol ngo Jesus yesa hatefali tarmal we ngal molwe temal.

Iwe ngo panger rechokwe ngo re lluwdah irel kkelel mala kkamelal Deus. Jesus Yesa Wol Kapta Kofal Yal Be Mes (Matthew 17:22–23; Mark 9:30–32) Yarmat re chil luluwaley fedaley pangal mokwe Jesus ye foforu ngo Jesus yesa kangalur mokwe redabeyal bo,
“Ha towe maligli mele ibele kangalugmi! Mala Layur Retalop ila ye bele yoh long lal payur yarmat.”
Iwe ngo mokwe redabeyel Jesus re togla fael molwe ye kangalur. Fal mele ila Deus ye hamwalo tangir bo rede medaf iyang ngo ir re motog bo rebe kasiy kofal molwe.
Itey Mele Ye Hartael Tagiyet?
Resa rol happaliyel fengal mokwe redabeyel Jesus hare itey semal mo luwulur le ye hartael tagiyet.
Jesus ye gola luluwal kowe yar. Iwe yesa hasi semal yalwich yesa hasu lengchel.

Iwe yesa kangalur bo, “Te tugul semal le yebe hammale semal tappel yalwich le, le fal mele idey ngo ye hammalyey. Iwe ngo te tugul semal le yebe hammalyey ngo ye wol hammale yeramtala ye fangdoh ngang. Yeramtala ye hartael totol mo luwulumi pangmiloh, ila yeramtala ye hartael tagiyet.”
Semal Le Be Tema Hapaliyel Ngalugmi Ila Ngo Iy Choluwami
John yesa sor bo, “Masta, ha wiri semal mal le ye kkachuchu moniyan fael idem. Iwe ngo hasa kangalu bo yebe ppoloh bo te iy chilach.”
Jesus sa kangalur mo mokwe redabeyal bo, “Ha towe hapolaho bele semal le be tema happaliyel ngalugmi ngo iy choluwami.”
Chol Haplomol Samaria We Te Deper Bo Be Budoh Jesus Irer
Yodwe sa harep yael Jesus loh wol laeng ngo yesa hatugulu mo lal depal le bele loh Jerusalem. Iwe sa chuy sa loh.
Yesa hamwowar loh mokwe re kakal yalol irel sew haplom mo wol Samaria bo re bela hafle pangal formel.
Iwe ngo yeramtal haplom we rete dipli bo Jesus yebe budoh irer bo resa faesul gola bo iy le ye loloh Jerusalem.
Yodwe James mo John we redabeyal rela gola molwe ngo resa sor bo, “Samol, ho dipli le habe fofosdiy yaef mo wol laeng bo be bidiy llirloh?”
Yesa tagul Jesus sa kkaftoroy ngalir.
Iwe Jesus mo mokwe redabeyal resa loh mo wol sew haplom.
Rechokla Medalbo Ir Redabeyel Jesus
Yodwe re loloh ngo semal mal yesa kangalu Jesus bo, “Te tugul lobos le hobe loh iyang ngo ngang ibe daboh.”
Jesus yesa kangalu bo, “Fox mwo ngo yor liliyer, ngo mael yeyal ka ngo yor hafter, ngo mala Layur Retalop ila tor solbos le liliyel yal hasoso.”
Jesus yesa wol kangal semal mal bo, “Dabeyey.” Mal we yesa sor bo, “Ibe loh mwo ibela leba mala temay.”
Jesus sa kangal mal we bo, “Ligdir chomes bo rebe leba yar mes. Ho loh ho bela foloyu ngalir yarmat kofal mala Lamliyel Deus.”
Semal mal sa wol sor bo, “Samol, ibe daboh ngo hal ila ibe loh mwo ibela habungur mekla yeramtay.”
Jesus yesa kangalu bo, “Semal le be kamchogchogu bol yal milay ngo ye kekal tefael chog, ila ngo iy ila tor pelal ngal mala Lamliyel Deus.”
